limitations: Only degree-zero and degree-one integral regular GLMY path homology and persistence are classified.
The nonreciprocal stable regime already appears over every field in Tang--Yau, Theorem 3.15; its novelty is not asserted here.
Arbitrary noninterval connection sets and higher-degree homology beyond the boundary remain unclassified.
